Provenance
Made by hand at Victoria Yards printmaking studio, Johannesburg — September 2019

Made by hand at a printmaking studio at Victoria Yards in Johannesburg, following a trip to the red sand dunes of Sossusvlei in the Namib-Naukluft National Park. The image captures the dune landscape — scattered desert plants in white against a deep burgundy-black ground, a smoldering horizon, the feeling of being very small inside something very large.

Victoria Yards is a creative complex in Johannesburg’s Lorentzville neighborhood, home to artists, makers, and studios. The printmaking workshop there uses a traditional etching press — a plate is inked, paper is laid over it, and the image is transferred by running it through heavy rollers by hand.

Making the print at Victoria Yards, Johannesburg — September 2019

The trip to Namibia included sleeping under open stars in the red sand dunes — the kind of night that changes how you understand silence and scale. This print was made in its wake.
